bugs.name: Settings saves a disabled merge style as "Default Merge Style" and new PRs then ignore it
bugs.summary: 'Default Merge Style' always lists all five styles regardless of the ticked 'Merge Styles'. After saving with only 'Create squash commit' enabled and default 'Create merge commit', the settings page keeps and displays the disabled style as the default, and the PR merge box silently falls back to 'Create squash commit' — the stored default is never applied and the settings page misreports it. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/settings (Advanced Settings → Pull Requests))
bugs.expected: The 'Default Merge Style' dropdown should offer only the merge styles enabled in 'Merge Styles' (or the save should refuse/repair a default that is disabled), so the saved default is a style that is actually allowed and the PR merge box uses it.
bugs.actual: 'Default Merge Style' always lists all five styles regardless of the ticked 'Merge Styles'. After saving with only 'Create squash commit' enabled and default 'Create merge commit', the settings page keeps and displays the disabled style as the default, and the PR merge box silently falls back to 'Create squash commit' — the stored default is never applied and the settings page misreports it.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iyhuwnqi1q5k6kqzc08au.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/settings
Scroll to the Advanced Settings panel, section 'Pull Requests' → 'Merge Styles'.

Tick only 'Create squash commit' (untick 'Create merge commit', 'Rebase then fast-forward', 'Rebase then create merge commit', 'Fast-forward only'; 'Manually merged' stays unticked), open 'Default Merge Style' and choose 'Create merge commit', then click 'Update Settings'.
Reload the page and read the same section: only 'Create squash commit' is ticked, but 'Default Merge Style' still shows 'Create merge commit'.
Open https://5503-iyhuwnqi1q5k6kqzc08au.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/20 (PR 'agent12 settings merge style PR'): the merge button reads 'Create squash commit', not the configured default.
